iti72:2.3: Kāmānam-etaṃ nissaraṇaṃ yad-idaṃ nekkhammaṃ, rūpānam-etaṃ nissaraṇaṃ yadidaṃ āruppaṃ, yaṃ kho pana kiñci bhūtaṃ saṅkhataṃ paṭiccasamuppannaṃ nirodho tassa nissaraṇaṃ.
iti72:2.4: Imā kho bhikkhave tisso nissaraṇiyā dhātuyo ti.
